strategies.name: Blueprint
strategies.goal: The standard plan: momentum and dip entries, locks in gains when the trend fades.

strategies.name: Riveter
strategies.goal: Many quick, short trades on tokens with active momentum. In fast, out fast.

strategies.name: Highrise
strategies.goal: Climbs with stronger moves and holds them longer, floor by floor.

strategies.name: Excavator
strategies.goal: Digs into pullbacks after a run instead of chasing green candles.

strategies.name: Surveyor
strategies.goal: Measures every setup twice: trades less often and only enters the strongest ones.

strategies.name: Demolition (New Pairs)
strategies.goal: Trades brand-new pump.fun coins in their first minutes, with tiny positions, quick profits and hard exits. Most new coins go to zero: this builder can lose all of its SOL.
